challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two Alex-initiated one-on-one plans, especially the Saturday museum visit, meaningfully support possible special interest, although C1-F4 shows that Alex also makes one-on-one plans with other friends.
Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing Jordan's preferred tea demonstrate personalized attention, but C1-F4 indicates that Alex also checks on and brings treats to others.
Four extended private conversations provide repeated evidence that Alex particularly enjoys engaging with Jordan and strengthen A, though they do not by themselves establish romantic interest.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B is retained, but with reduced confidence. C1-F1 through C1-F3 collectively provide meaningful evidence of special attention. However, C1-F4 supplies a direct general-friendliness explanation for much of that behavior, while C1-F5 contains no explicit romantic indication and C1-F6 shows limited follow-through on Jordan's dinner proposal. On balance, B remains somewhat better supported rather than decisively established.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: The evidence supports continued ambiguity with B modestly ahead. Observing whether Alex independently follows up or proposes another specific one-on-one plan would provide more useful evidence without assuming romantic intent.
